title: Empowered Ambessa in base (not in combat) is still dealt spell damage.
expected: ven-084-166 exists only in packages/riftbound-cards/src/data/sets/ven.json with abilities:[] and parseSuccess:false (no TS override anywhere in packages/ or apps/). unitIgnoresDamage (damage-immunity.ts:36-52) iterates registry abilities looking for static restriction 'no-damage'; with an empty ability list it returns false, and conditionHolds (lines 21-34) only recognizes 'moved-this-turn' — there is no empowered/not-in-combat condition. So damage.ts applies Falling Star's damage to Empowered Ambessa in base.
observed: After resolving Falling Star with both targets = Ambessa, her meta showed damage: 6 (__counters.damage 6, lastDamageSource 'spell') while empowered: true and located in base with no combat/showdown. Engine damage-immunity (operations/damage-immunity.ts) only supports a 'moved-this-turn' condition; no 'empowered && not in combat' restriction is registered for this card (ven.json parseSuccess:false, abilities:[]).
